dedupe_keys.name: jao py cross border electricity auction client

description: jao-py is a Python client for the Joint Allocation Office electricity transmission-capacity data endpoints. Its README identifies JAO's cross-border e-CAT platform and documents pandas clients for retrieving selected auction or capacity data. Users choose an endpoint and period; outputs are tables that can be joined to European market or network studies. Geographic coverage follows the JAO interconnector and bidding-zone services queried. GitHub metadata states MIT licensing for the client; JAO API access and data terms remain separate. A limitation is that the package deliberately implements only some endpoints and may lag changes in the provider interface. Auctioned capacity is also not the same as physical flow or actual grid availability. It can prepare cross-border market constraints for power-system simulations. The related OSeMOSYS catalogue model optimises pathways but does not query JAO. No transmission data or package was downloaded.
